items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: I met him. I met him in New Iberia.

ctx.x: There's a fellow by the name of Weegee Payne. Did you ever know him, the drummer, Weegee? Yeah, I met him.
I met him. I met him in New Iberia. Was he from that part of the country? I don't know where he was from.
